style: A hand-made cut-paper collage style, like a 1950s children's picture book made from coloured paper: every object is built from flat pieces of cut or torn coloured paper with a subtle paper grain and slightly irregular hand-cut edges, simple drawn lines for details, tiny soft shadows where paper layers overlap, no painterly shading and no gradients, in a limited warm palette of honey stone, cream, sage and olive greens, duck-egg blue, mustard, tomato red and teal.
sheetRules: A sprite sheet of exactly 12 separate objects arranged in a neat grid of 4 columns and 3 rows, each object isolated with generous empty space around it and not touching any other object, all drawn at a consistent scale, lit from the upper left, seen from a slight three-quarter eye-level view. The background must be one perfectly flat, solid, uniform pure magenta colour (#FF00FF) with no texture, no shadows, no gradients and no ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.

villagers.prompt: OVERRIDE: exactly 8 head-and-shoulders character portraits arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each portrait cut out as its own oval of coloured paper with a torn cream paper edge, generous magenta space between them. redrawRules: The first image shows the art style: a picture made entirely of flat pieces of cut coloured paper and felt, with a fine paper grain, simple hand-cut edges, very little shading and no shine. The second image is an old sprite sheet: use it ONLY for which objects to draw, their pose, orientation, proportions and position in the grid. Rebuild every object from scratch in the style of the first image: made of a few flat pieces of cut paper layered together, simple bold shapes, matte colours, no painted shading, no metallic or glassy highlights, no fine hatching or ink lines, so that each object would sit naturally in the first image. Signs and boards stay blank.
